1617.note: Stadtarchiv Nuernberg E 29/IV Nr. 456 is a letter of 19 Jan 1534 (not 1490) in which 'Geheimschrift' is only an index term, with no description of any cipher and no scan.

seen.where: https://www.archivportal-d.de/item/ORHN3M5S2YY66AW7DRCQDLCF3D7SCKWY (opened in Chrome 5 Nov 2026; Stadtarchiv Nuernberg E 29/IV Nr. 456)
seen.extent: 2 leaves, 1 1/2 written pages; a list of mercenaries' names originally pasted on the back is now loose with it.
seen.cipher: The record gives Laufzeit 19.01.1534 and lists 'Geheimschrift' and 'Geheimhaltung' among the Indexbegriffe Sache beside Reiseplanung, Soeldner, Geleit; the Bemerkungen describe only the mercenary list. It never says that part of the letter is in cipher, how much, or of what kind, so the leaf cannot be judged cipher or secrecy talk.
